headline: Genmab Ovarian Cancer Drug Meets Primary Goals in Phase 3 Trial
summary: Genmab announced that its phase 3 clinical trial evaluating an ovarian cancer drug successfully met its primary endpoints.
why: Successful late-stage trial results are key regulatory milestones for biotechnology companies, paving the way for commercialization and revenue diversification.

impacts.name: Genmab
impacts.why: Positive phase 3 data significantly improves the probability of regulatory approval and future drug sales.

why_moved: Meeting late-stage clinical endpoints significantly lowers pipeline risk and expands the company's prospective therapeutic portfolio.
